title: Bitcoin fell 1.3% while Nasdaq-100 lost 5.5% in last week’s tech selloff
summary: Bitcoin lost less than the Nasdaq-100 in last week's tech selloff. Hedge funds cut technology positions at the fastest pace since at least 2016 over the five trading sessions through Oct. 15, according to a report citing Goldman Sachs prime brokerage data.
